solution: The opening section says Pandit Nehru "set up the Indian Atomic Energy Commission on 10th August 1948. Dr Homi Bhabha was appointed as the first Chairman of the Commission." Dr Homi Sethna is the trap: the chapter later calls him "the chairman of the Indian Atomic Energy Commission" at the time of the 1974 Pokharan test — a chairman, but not the first. Dr Raja Ramanna is named as Director of BARC and Dr Kalam as the missile-programme leader.

The chapter states: "APPLE (Ariane Passenger Payload Experiment) : The first completely indigenously built satellite by ISRO in India, APPLE was launched on 19th June 1981 from the French Guiana", and credits it with emergency telecommunication services. Aryabhatta (1975) is the tempting rival but the chapter says it was launched "with help from the Soviet Russia" and it was not a communication satellite; Rohini-75 was an indigenous rocket, not a satellite; INSAT 1-B came later, in August 1983.
